yorum: Our stay at La Blanche Island Bodrum exceeded all our expectations. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the hotel’s unique location on a beautiful peninsula, surrounded by breathtaking views of the Aegean Sea. The spacious and elegant reception area immediately gave us a luxurious first impression, and every member of the staff was incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful throughout our entire stay. Our room was spacious, modern, and spotlessly clean. It was cleaned every day, and the minibar was refilled daily with soft drinks and bottled water. These little touches made our holiday even more comfortable. The pools are fantastic, always clean and well-maintained. The water slides were a huge hit with our daughter, who couldn’t wait to go back every day. The private beach is beautiful, with crystal-clear water, and one thing we really appreciated was that we never had to “fight” for a sunbed. No matter what time we arrived, there were always plenty available. Fresh beach towels were provided every day, which was another great convenience. The food was excellent in every way. The main restaurant offered an incredible variety of fresh and delicious dishes at every meal. The Starbucks on the resort opens at noon and is a great place to enjoy a quality coffee or refreshing drink. The Sweet Corner serves delicious ice cream, fresh fruit, and freshly made waffles throughout the day, while the dessert bar in the lobby offers a wonderful selection of cakes and pastries for anyone with a sweet tooth. In the evenings, the Lobby Bar became our favourite place to relax before or after the shows, serving excellent cocktails in a lovely atmosphere. During the day, we spent a lot of time at the Pool Bar, where Mehmet made the best cocktails in the hotel. He is not only an incredibly talented bartender but also one of the friendliest and most attentive people we met. After just a few days, he already remembered our favourite drinks and always welcomed us with a smile. We truly enjoyed chatting with him every day, and he became one of the highlights of our holiday. The evening entertainment was excellent every single night, with professional shows, live music, children’s performances, followed by DJ parties and dancing. There was always something enjoyable for guests of every age. During the day, the Entertainment Team, led by Sercan, did a fantastic job organizing sports and pool activities. Aqua fitness, water games, beach volleyball, and many other activities created a fun atmosphere throughout the day. Sercan and his team were energetic, friendly, and enthusiastic without ever being pushy. They made everyone feel welcome and encouraged participation in a relaxed and enjoyable way. Families with children will also appreciate the Kids Club, which is open throughout the day. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An Unforgettable Holiday at La Blanche Island, Bodrum We had yet another incredible stay at La Blanche Island and can honestly say it is still the best hotel i have ever been to. From the moment we arrived, we were blown away by the stunning location and breathtaking views that surround the island. Wherever you looked, there were spectacular panoramic sea views, crystal-clear waters, and beautiful scenery that made every day feel special. The hotel itself is outstanding – immaculately maintained, beautifully designed, and offering everything you could possibly need for a relaxing and enjoyable holiday. The facilities were excellent, and the attention to detail throughout the resort was impressive. The food was another highlight of our stay. The Turkish à la carte restaurant was exceptional and an absolute must-visit. Every dish was full of flavour, beautifully presented, and gave us a wonderful taste of authentic Turkish cuisine. The quality of food throughout the resort was consistently excellent. What truly sets La Blanche Island apart, however, is its people. Every member of staff we encountered was friendly, welcoming, and genuinely happy to help. From the housekeeping team who kept our room spotless, to the waiters and waitresses who always served us with a smile, the reception staff who were professional and accommodating, and even the gardeners who work tirelessly to keep the grounds looking beautiful – everyone contributed to making our stay memorable. A very special thank you goes to the entertainment team, especially Murat, whose energy, enthusiasm, and hard work created a fantastic atmosphere throughout our holiday. They made sure there was always something fun happening for both adults and children. We would also like to give special recognition to the wonderful girls at the Kids Club, who were absolutely fantastic with my little girl. Their kindness, patience, and dedication meant she had an amazing time and looked forward to seeing them every day. They truly helped make our holiday extra special. Thank you to everyone at La Blanche Island for giving us such wonderful memories. We can't wait to return for a 3rd visit and would highly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a beautiful resort, amazing food, outstanding service, and an unforgettable holiday experience.

In my opinion, this hotel does not offer good value for the price you pay. * The elevator system is poorly managed, and you often have to wait a long time to use it. * The hotel is very crowded most of the time. * The Family Rooms are quite small and feel cramped for a family. * Housekeeping lacks consistency and attention to detail. On several occasions, parts of the room were not cleaned properly, and some trash was left behind. * In our room, the shower drain was clogged with hair and sand, and unfortunately, it was not properly taken care of. * I believe the hotel management should supervise and regularly evaluate the housekeeping team more carefully. * Overall, the level of service, cleanliness, and organization does not match the price of the hotel. On the positive side: * The food is very good. * The drinks are of good quality. * The water activities and related facilities are enjoyable and well maintained. In the end, a large part of what you are paying for is the incredible view and the hotel’s excellent location. The scenery is truly stunning. I haven’t stayed at the nearby hotels, but if there is another hotel in the same area with larger rooms, better service, and higher standards of cleanliness and organization, I would definitely recommend choosing that instead.

We are currently here and sad to say its our last day. We are a couple in our 50s we have enjoyed our stay. Food is delicious and plentiful. You get a free al a carte for each 7 days. Also branded drinks my hubby enjoyed the jack Daniels. The staff are all friendly and work hard not had any rude staff as written in other reviews. The white wine and prosecco are also good. The main restaurant has an abundance of good quality food, A grill station, a kebab station, pizza and pide station, a vast selection of salads and meze, cold meats , cheeses, chips,pasta,rice, noodles , sea food, fruit and a dessert selection to die for also ice cream man. The sunrise snack bar is great for pizzas, kebabs and burgers and chips. All served to you through a scan code which are on your table, had no issues ordering at all The pools are clean and large. The views are out of this world. Entertainment is a little cheesey but we enjoyed it and had a laugh. The lobby bar serves all drinks staff go above and beyond and will bring your drinks to you. The staff in the restaurants are attentive and friendly. We had a Turkish bath and a massage booked through Andy who walks round the pool most days and always acknowledged us very nice guy I could go on for ever there is so much here. Take no notice of the bad reviews We would definitely recommend and come back . Thankyou all at la blanche you have made our stay fabulous

The hotel staff were all very friendly and helpful, especially Yunus at the sunset bar, and Andy who arranged the Turkish massages, rooms were very good and clean. Will definitely return to this hotel, prices do vary quite a lot depending on when you stay so would suggest you pick your dates carefully. I must add that I've read some awful reviews from some, complaining about pretty much everything, my honest opinion of this is that some people are never satisfied unless they are complaining about something or someone, if you treat the hotel staff with respect, you get treated with respect in return.

Wow where do I start? We booked over a year ago and were looking forward to it but recent reviews on here and Facebook did make me ponder however I tend to roll my eyes at negative English reviews as they focus on spirits (why?) and food. Well I need not have worried! Firstly it’s important to note it cost us £1900 for a week for 2 adults and 1 child in half term, so my expectations are low, as long as we can swim and there’s at least chips and salad we will survive! Food Considering we are here for the last week of the season I found the food to be fantastic. Slow roasted lamb, beef short ribs, fresh fish and local pasta dishes plus lots of salad and bread choices. Delicious soups. Fabulous omelette bar at breakfast again with lots of options but breakfast is breakfast! I can see why some British don’t like it, there’s no chicken nuggets for a start or pork. So if these things are important book elsewhere. Ala cartes we tried were the two open, Turkish & fish. Both are brilliant. The coffee shop and patisserie are lovely. Ice creams on the beach good too. We don’t drink alcohol so doesn’t phase us. Good soft drink selection. Probably the best coffee I’ve ever had at an AI (swerve the Starbucks imo). Cafe Blanche really is lovely. Location Gorgeous location, so lovely and quiet with a beautiful beach. Again seen lots of moaning about this but honestly it’s the end of October the sea and pool will be cooler! All 3 of us had no issues in swimming though. The sea is my preferred choice. The slides were good fun too ☺️ lots of lovely snorkelling able to be done! We also got a free room upgrade which was AMAZING! I really love that you can get your steps in round this hotel. Spa Had a fantastic deal from Andy, going to try and book another for our last day! Yes they have conferences on but this is the norm in low season across Europe too. None of us were offended by knitted body parts Staff Staff are fantastic, I learnt basic Turkish and would recommend people do this. Really lovely service when tipping people properly. They even charged my kindle at reception for me! The only “negatives” are that entertainment starts at midnight but that doesn’t bother us. I’ve never stayed at the same hotel twice but we are coming back next October we enjoyed it that much ☺️

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely Incredible Holiday! We have just returned from a fantastic stay at La Blanche Island and cannot recommend it enough. The service throughout the entire hotel was impeccable from start to finish. Every member of staff went above and beyond to make our stay special, and the level of hospitality was outstanding. A huge shout-out to the entertainment team, who were genuinely 10/10. Sergio, Yacub, and the lovely lady who ran the water polo and volleyball (I believe her name was Amnur) were absolutely brilliant. They brought so much energy every day, made everyone feel welcome, and danced with us every night. They truly made our holiday unforgettable and are a credit to the hotel. The highlight of our stay was undoubtedly Sakura, the Asian restaurant. It is honestly some of the best food we’ve ever eaten. After dining there once for my birthday, we loved it so much that we wanted to go back immediately, and Ishak from Guest Relations kindly arranged another booking for us on the same day. The food was simply to die for. Special thanks to Cholpon, Emirhan, Ozgur, and all of the servers, who provided exceptional service and made every meal a wonderful experience. The location is stunning, with beautiful views and plenty to do. Whether you want to spend your day relaxing on the beach or taking part in sports, games, and activities, there is something for everyone. The evening entertainment was excellent every night and kept the atmosphere lively and enjoyable. The entire island is simply breathtaking. It is definitely a family-oriented hotel that caters brilliantly to all ages, making it the perfect destination for a luxury family holiday. Equally, if you’re someone who enjoys staying active and having lots to do throughout the day, this is the place for you. Thank you to everyone at La Blanche Island for such a memorable holiday. We will definitely be back!

This was the 2nd time we visited this resort, as we had been here two years ago. Many of the resort features are the same, great beach area, comfortable lounges, cleaned daily, a mini cabana like setting. The public areas are very clean and comfortable, and the all inclusive feature makes for a relaxing experience. This time though, the food was not as good as we expected, as previously it was very good from a selection standpoint and flavorful. This time many selections were cold, when they were expected to be hot. There were not as many special items as there was previously. The rooms are pleasant, but not 5 star luxury. The bathrooms could use some fresh items, especially the shower. Overall I would recommend the property, if you are looking for great beach time, or pools, and enjoy the all inclusive feature, so you are not searching for food. It is great for kids also, as many families were enjoying the resort. Also many nationalities were represented in the guests on property. The service personnel are also able to speak many languages, so communication was easy.
